map.阳性与阴性症状量表(PANSS)评分计算器，供临床工作者对30个症状条目逐项评分: Positive and Negative Syndrome Scale (PANSS) scoring calculator for clinicians to rate 30 symptom items (1-7). Subscales: Positive P (7), Negative N (7), General G (16); total 30-210. PANSS is a clinician-rated scale requiring training.
map.PANSS总分 = 阳性分(7项) + 阴性分(7项) + 一般精神病理分(7项: PANSS total = positive (7) + negative (7) + general psychopathology (7); composite = positive - negative; <=57 none/minimal, 58-74 mild, 75-95 moderate, >=96 marked/severe.
map.本量表为临床评定工具的计算辅助，不能替代精神科专业诊断。PANSS须由经训练的临: This is a calculation aid for a clinician-rated scale and does not replace psychiatric diagnosis. PANSS must be rated by trained clinicians based on interview and observation.
map.30 项各 1–7：阳性 7 项合计 21（P1–P7）、阴性 7 项合计 18: 30 items each 1-7: positive 7 sum 21 (P1-P7), negative 7 sum 18 (N1-N7), general 16 sum 38 -> total 77, positive-negative diff = 3, slightly higher positive.
map.阳性 16、阴性 24、一般 24 → 64，阴性因子突出，提示预后与认知康复需: Positive 16, negative 24, general 24 -> 64, negative factor prominent, implying prognosis and cognitive rehab need focus.
map.阳性分 = P1–P7，阴性分 = N1–N7，一般 = G1–G16；总分越高: Positive = P1-P7, negative = N1-N7, general = G1-G16; higher total means worse symptoms; often paired with CGI for efficacy.
map.需由认证评定者依据近一周表现，按锚定描述 1–7 计分，避免受患者配合度影响。: A certified rater must score 1-7 by anchored descriptions based on the past week, avoiding influence from patient cooperation.
